div.head: Wer 7
div.ab: Eal man sceal æt cyrliscum were be þære mæðe don, ðe him to gebyreð, swa we be twelfhyndum tealdan.
Eal man sceal æt cyrliscum were be ðære mæðe don, ðe him to gebyreð, swa we be twelfhundum tealdan.
Eodem modo per omnia debet de cyrlisci hominis wera fieri secundum mensuram, quę pertinet ei, sicut de tƿelfhindo narrauimus.
Bei gemeinfreiem Wergeld muss gemäss dem Verhältniss, das für diesen [Gemeinfreien] sich gebührt, ganz so verfahren werden, wie wir über das 1200 [Schilling betragende] gesagt haben.
With a ceorl's wergild one must proceed entirely in the same way, in the proportion that is due for this [ceorl], as we have said about the 1200 [shilling] one.
With a ceorl's wergeld, everyone shall proceed along the lines proper for him, as we reckoned for twelve-hundred men.
